title: CockroachDB Cluster Operations
description: Cluster-wide SQL performance, node liveness, range replication, leaseholders, and storage capacity for CockroachDB.

panels.title: Scrape Targets Healthy
panels.description: CockroachDB nodes currently reachable by Prometheus.

panels.title: Live Nodes
panels.description: Live nodes reported by CockroachDB liveness.

panels.title: Cluster SQL QPS
panels.description: SQL query throughput across all nodes.

panels.title: P95 SQL Latency
panels.description: Cluster-wide P95 SQL execution latency.

panels.title: SQL Queries by Node
panels.description: Per-node SQL query throughput.

panels.title: SQL Latency by Node
panels.description: Per-node P95 SQL execution latency.

panels.title: CPU Utilization by Node
panels.description: Normalized CockroachDB process CPU by node.

panels.title: Memory RSS by Node
panels.description: Resident CockroachDB process memory by node.

panels.title: Unavailable Ranges
panels.description: Ranges unavailable for reads or writes. This should remain zero.

panels.title: Under-Replicated Ranges
panels.description: Ranges below their configured replication factor.

panels.title: Over-Replicated Ranges
panels.description: Ranges above their configured replication factor.

panels.title: Non-Live Nodes
panels.description: Configured scrape targets minus CockroachDB live nodes.

panels.title: Range Replication Health
panels.description: Unavailable, under-replicated, over-replicated, and uninitialized ranges.

panels.title: Leaseholder Distribution
panels.description: Range leaseholders by node. Large skew can concentrate SQL traffic.

panels.title: Heartbeat Failures by Node
panels.description: Node-liveness heartbeat failures per second.

panels.title: Heartbeat P95 Latency
panels.description: P95 node-liveness heartbeat latency in milliseconds.

panels.title: Lease Transfer Outcomes
panels.description: Successful and failed lease transfers per second.

panels.title: Storage Used
panels.description: Total capacity used across cluster stores.

panels.title: Storage Available
panels.description: Total available capacity across cluster stores.

panels.title: Storage Utilization
panels.description: Cluster used capacity as a percentage of used plus available.

panels.title: Reserved Capacity
panels.description: Capacity reserved across cluster stores.

panels.title: Storage Used by Node
panels.description: Current used capacity by node.

panels.title: Storage Available by Node
panels.description: Current available capacity by node.

panels.title: SQL Connections by Node
panels.description: Current SQL client connections per node.

panels.title: CPU Utilization by Node
panels.description: Normalized process CPU utilization per node.
